#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
    string line;
    istringstream iss;
public:
    FastReader() {}
    
    string next() {
        string token;
        while (!(iss >> token)) {
            getline(cin, line);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        return token;
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class TaskB {
private:
    bool inside;
    int insideWords;
    int maxOutside;
    int currentLen;

public:
    void solve(int testNumber, FastReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string str = in.nextLine();
        const char* chars = str.c_str();
        inside = false;
        insideWords = 0;
        maxOutside = 0;
        currentLen = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = chars[i];
            if (c == '(') {
                flushWord();
                inside = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                flushWord();
                inside = false;
            } else if (c == '_') {
                flushWord();
            } else {
                currentLen++;
            }
        }
        flushWord();
        out << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;
    }

    void flushWord() {
        if (currentLen > 0) {
            if (inside) {
                insideWords++;
            } else if (currentLen > maxOutside) {
                maxOutside = currentLen;
            }
            currentLen = 0;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    FastReader in;
    ostream& out = cout;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
